Keep good track of your hot spring tickets, they're a great way 
to maximize the <color=#ff9900>power of the hot springs</color> during summer!
63.332:
Sources have their own attributes, lending <color=#ff9900>different effects</color> 
to excavated springs! The power of these effects can be felt 
when using a <color=#ff9900>hot spring ticket</color> to enter the baths. Moreover, 
<color=#ff9900>recovery might be supercharged</color> when fatigued, increasing 
stats and allowing energy to recover past the usual bounds!
63.333: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.334:
In this scenario, the horsegirls' shared goal of achieving <color=#ff911c>victory
at the Breeder's Cup</color> takes precedence over other desires!
They'll have only one chance, on the <color=#ff911c>first half of November 
during the senior year</color>. Join the team members in this campaign 
of victory and mutual inspiration!
63.335:
Work hand in hand with your <color=#ff911c>team</color> to achieve a victory 
at the Breeder's Cup. <color=#ff911c>You will need every member if you 
are to take home first place there</color>, so train as one and 
become ever stronger, as a team!
63.336:
In <color=#ff911c>Strategy Meetings</color> there are 3 different <color=#ff911c>team stats you 
can upgrade</color> using <color=#ff911c>DP</color>. These stats will <color=#ff911c>affect the bonuses 
you get from DREAMS Training</color>! DP <color=#ff911c>cannot be reallocated</color>
later, so choose carefully!
63.337:
During the summer camp, <color=#ff911c>team members' dream gauge 
will rise every turn</color>. It's a great chance to increase
their rank, so keep an eye on that gauge!
63.338:
Trainer information can be viewed and set here. You can 
expect special comments from the active home screen 
horsegirl on your <color=#ff9900>birthday</color>, and some scenario content 
might change depending on your <color=#ff9900>gender</color>. 
(Gender can be changed at any time)
63.340:
You can select the Star Horsegirl and support 
card of the friends you <color=#ff9900>follow</color> from each list in training. 
You also earn more Friend Pt by helping a <color=#ff9900>mutual follower</color> 
to train. If you don't have many followers, try looking 
in the <color=#ff9900>recommendations</color>.
63.341:
Create your own <color=#ff9900>Trainer Card</color>, and share it as an image on 
social media. Show your info along with horsegirl, support and 
<color=#ff9900>customizable graphics</color>.
63.343:
You can procure <color=#ff9900>up to 10 Legacy-only Horsegirls per day</color>.
Just like in a Career, these horsegirls can develop various
traits based on support cards used and races entered.
63.344:
Use <color=#ff9900>Procurement</color> to obtain and save <color=#ff9900>Legacy-only Horsegirls</color>. 
These horsegirls can't participate in races or the Stadium, 
but their legacies can be inherited when starting a Career.
Make good use of these to train strong horsegirls!
63.345:
You can configure <color=#ff9900>up to 10 Preferred Traits</color>. 
Obtaining these will be prioritised.
63.346:
Use <color=#ff9900>Procurement</color> to obtain and save <color=#ff9900>Legacy-only Horsegirls</color>. 
These horsegirls can't participate in races or the Stadium, 
but their legacies can be inherited when starting a Career.
Additionally, these horsegirls will disappear when transferred
and cannot be restored.
63.349:
After obtaining a score, you can enter your trainee in separate 
rankings <color=#ff9900>grouped by horsegirl</color> to obtain a <color=#ff9900>special title</color>!
※ Only one horsegirl can enter in the rankings.
※ You can change your choice once within the allotted period.
63.350:
The BC race selected as your <color=#ff911c>ultimate goal</color> will affect which 
races you and your trainee will enter on the way there.
Goals matching her aptitudes are marked <color=#ff911c>"Recommended!"</color>,
so use that as your guide should you feel lost!
63.351:
Training with your team members means <color=#ff911c>more stats for you</color>
and a <color=#ff911c>rising dream gauge for them</color>. When a member's gauge
is <color=#ff911c>filled</color> after having risen thrice, <color=#ff911c>they will rank up</color> next time 
you train together! Seek out your team members in training 
whenever you can!
63.352:
Your team rank is based on the members with the <color=#ff911c>lowest rank</color>.
Higher team rank confers a <color=#ff911c>Friendship Bonus and other positive 
effects</color>. Team rank is also an important part of <color=#ff911c>Reviews</color>, so don't
just focus on a few members, <color=#ff911c>keep everyone's ranks high</color>!
63.353:
As you progress, <color=#ff911c>DREAMS Training</color> will become available.
When activating DREAMS Training, <color=#ff911c>all 3 team members and up 
to 5 supports from your deck will appear on all training facilities</color>!
You have a limited number of activations, and while Reviews
will recover these, <color=#ff911c>there's a limit</color> to how many you can have!
63.354:
Throughout your Career, 5 <color=#ff911c>Review</color> events will take place, 
and each one <color=#ff911c>demands a certain minimum Team Rank</color>.
The results will determine <color=#ff911c>how much DP</color> you can use
in the Strategy Meeting and the <color=#ff911c>rewards</color> you get.
Pay attention to your Team Rank!
63.355:
In <color=#ff911c>Strategy Meetings</color> there are 3 different <color=#ff911c>team stats you 
can upgrade</color> using <color=#ff911c>DP</color>. These stats will <color=#ff911c>affect the bonuses 
you get from DREAMS Training</color>! DP <color=#ff911c>cannot be reallocated</color>
later, so choose carefully!
63.356: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.357:
In Practice, you can freely hold races under <color=#ff9900>any conditions 
you want</color>. In addition to the Veterans you have trained, 
you can also run races with <color=#ff9900>other trainers' horsegirls</color>. 
You can hold practice with up to 18 horsegirls at once!
63.358:
If you see horsegirls you like in the Team Stadium, 
Room Match, or elsewhere, you can register them 
as <color=#ff9900>Training Partners</color> so that you can run friendly races 
together. The Star Horsegirls of the trainers you follow 
are also available.
63.359:
You can <color=#ff9900>share</color> your favorite <color=#ff9900>Veteran Horsegirls</color> with your 
Club and online. Actively register your Practice Partners 
from Club members and friends to enhance your practice!
63.360:
Save horsegirls in <color=#ff9900>My Entrants</color> to <color=#ff9900>select them easily</color> during 
registration! You can also save them from the results screen. 
Removing Training Partners will remove them from My Entrants 
as well, so be careful!
63.361:
In the Independent Career mode a Career will <color=#ff9900>complete on its
own</color> according to your defined career style and race schedule.
※ Unlike other Career modes, this mode is entirely automated.
63.362:
Using this mode, <color=#ff9900>you are free</color> to enter in racing events or
enjoy the stories and the rest of the game <color=#ff9900>while a Career
completes</color> in the background.
63.363:
In cooperation with venues throughout the country,
Tracen's horsegirls bring ramen to race fans to thank
them for their constant support! Make time in your training
to research local ramen varieties and get that excitement
going at the end-of-year <color=#ff911c>Ramen Jamborees</color>!
63.364:
It's time to choose which regions' ramen to research over
the coming year! <color=#ff911c>Each year</color> you can choose <color=#ff911c>3 regions</color>, out
of a total of 10. The ramen and its <color=#ff911c>effects when prepared
differ</color> per region, so pay attention when selecting!
63.365:
To make ramen, first you need some expertise with its
constituents! Expertise comes in <color=#ff911c>3 groups</color>, and you can
hold <color=#ff911c>up to 10</color> at a time. You'll <color=#ff911c>gain 1 expertise</color> when its
<color=#ff911c>associated gauge is filled</color>. These gauges will <color=#ff911c>increase by
a set amount every turn</color>, based on your actions.
63.366:
With the gathered expertise, you can hold <color=#ff911c>Taste Tests</color> for
each region's ramen at <color=#ff911c>any time</color>. These will confer <color=#ff911c>various
bonuses</color> during that turn only. You will also gain <color=#ff911c>Excitement
Points</color> from Taste Tests, which will <color=#ff911c>influence your Ramen
Jamborees</color>, so don't be afraid to taste that ramen!
63.367: This scenario provides <color=#ff9900>Autoplay</color>. This can be accessed through the button on the main training screen. Training will happen automatically, according to the selected plan, which you can also edit. Make use of autoplay for a more hands-off experience!
63.368:
It's time to choose which regions' ramen to research over
the coming year! <color=#ff911c>Each year</color> you can choose <color=#ff911c>3 regions</color>, out
of a total of 10. The ramen and its <color=#ff911c>effects when prepared
differ</color> per region, so pay attention when selecting!
63.369:
With the gathered expertise, you can hold <color=#ff911c>Taste Tests</color> for
each region's ramen at <color=#ff911c>any time</color>. These will confer <color=#ff911c>various
bonuses</color> during that turn only. You will also gain <color=#ff911c>Excitement
Points</color> from Taste Tests, which will <color=#ff911c>influence your Ramen
Jamborees</color>, so don't be afraid to taste that ramen!
63.370:
<color=#ff911c>Special seasonings</color> obtainable from <color=#ff911c>special events</color> can be
used to <color=#ff911c>fill in for missing expertise</color> when preparing ramen!
However, you can <color=#ff911c>only hold 4</color> of these, and <color=#ff911c>use 2 per Taste
Test</color>, so manage them carefully!
63.371:
<color=#ff911c>Every year after late december</color>, new knowledge is turned
into plans for the new year, and <color=#ff911c>gathered Expertise will
be reset</color>! Any <color=#ff911c>remaining expertise</color> lost this way is <color=#ff911c>converted
into energy</color>. Remaining <color=#ff911c>special seasonings will not reset</color>,
so plan wisely!
63.372:
A <color=#ff911c>Ramen Jamboree</color>, or <color=#ff911c>RMJ</color> for short, are events where
horsegirls can put all their gained ramen skill and knowledge
on display for attendees! A bigger <color=#ff911c>Turnout</color> increases not only
the fun, but your trainee's growth as well!
63.373:
You'll <color=#ff911c>gain 2 special seasonings</color> at the start of summer
camp, and <color=#ff911c>1 more every turn</color>! The summer is a perfect
time to enjoy ramen and Taste Tests' effects on training!
63.61:
Fenomeno sets out to investigate the archives in her role on the disciplinary committee.
Word has it that students have been sneaking inside. But neither stakeouts
nor questioning have turned up any leads! Anticipating their talents, she recruits
Samson Big, Shinko Windy, and others to form an investigative squad.
Will Fenomeno and her team be able to crack the case...?
63.253:
Save your favorite settings under <color=#ff9900>My Race Conditions</color> and load them
to easily host Room Matches!
You can also host matches with ease using conditions from upcoming race events via <color=#ff9900>Recommended Races</color>.
63.258:
The <color=#ff9900>UGE</color> is an evaluation test to assess a Mecha Umamusume's development.
It is held 5 times over 3 years, with ratings determined by your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>.
<color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color> increases based on the total Lv of all 5 research categories.
Since each period has a Lv cap, train in a balanced manner to efficiently raise your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>!
63.259:
When selecting training, <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> may appear at random!
Training with <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> grants bonus Research Lv gains,
boosts training effectiveness, and fills your Overdrive Gauge.
Furthermore, <color=#ff9900>Mecha Gears</color> are guaranteed to appear during Friendship Training!
63.260:
At the end of a UGE, you can allocate the <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color> you've earned
to tune your Mecha Umamusume.
Tuning can only be performed immediately following a UGE,
so plan ahead for the next six months of training when tuning.
63.261:
Filling the Overdrive Gauge to max allows you to activate <color=#ff9900>Overdrive</color>.
The effects of <color=#ff9900>Overdrive</color> vary depending on your tuning,
so be sure to choose the effects you need most!
63.262:
In <color=#ff9900>Tuning</color>, you enhance your Mecha Umamusume's performance by allocating <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color>
to the <color=#ff9900>Chips</color> installed in the Head, Chest, and Leg <color=#ff9900>Cores</color>.
Each chip boosts different training effects,
so choose wisely based on which stats you want to improve.
63.263:
The total amount of Mecha EN allocated to each core changes the <color=#ff9900>effects of Overdrive</color>.
Check the effect list and combine the bonuses you need
to tune an even more powerful Overdrive!
63.264:
Your results in the UGE will vary depending on your <color=#ff9900>Research Progress</color>.
Taking the UGE with "Promising Signs" will earn you an <color=#ff9900>S Rank</color>,
resulting in significant Umamusume stat growth.
Higher evaluations also award more <color=#ff9900>Mecha EN</color>, so aim for that <color=#ff9900>S Rank</color>!
63.289:
The Uma Jukebox is a feature that lets you <color=#ff9900>change the BGM</color> to any song from the track list.
Accessible from the right-hand menu, the Jukebox allows you to play your favorite tracks anywhere you like, including during training and on the Home screen.
63.292:
When a Trainee Umamusume with an evolvable Inherited Skill reaches 3★ or higher talent bloom,
and acquires that skill's hint at the start of training,
her Inherited Skill will evolve into a powerful Inherited Evolved Skill upon completing training.
63.297:
With <color=#ff9900>Swipe Controls</color>, swipe anywhere on the screen
to move the camera, and pinch to zoom.
To reset the camera to its default position,
tap the <color=#ff9900>[Reset Camera] button</color> in the bottom-left corner.
63.298:
With <color=#ff9900>Gyro Controls</color>, you can move the camera
by rotating or tilting your device.
*Zoom and camera reset controls are
the same as in Swipe Controls.
63.303:
With <color=#ff9900>Swipe Controls</color>, swipe anywhere on the screen
to move the camera, and pinch to zoom.
To reset the camera to its default position,
tap the <color=#ff9900>[Reset Camera] button</color> in the bottom-left corner.
63.304:
With <color=#ff9900>Gyro Controls</color>, you can move the camera
by rotating or tilting your device.
*Zoom and camera reset controls are
the same as in Swipe Controls.
63.313:
In the <color=#ff9901>Archives</color>, you can challenge limited-time races
previously featured in Master's Challenge at any time.
Your previous clear status will carry over.
*Limited-time races will be added to the Archives sequentially.
63.314:
With the Trainer Notebook, you can <color=#ff9900>skip</color> content like Daily Races and Team Stadium!
You can also <color=#ff9900>skip multiple activities at once</color>.
Set your <color=#ff9900>Skip Policy</color> and enjoy playing through various content with ease!
63.329:
<color=#ff9900>Uncap Crystals</color> can be exchanged for Support Cards that can be uncapped.
Exchanged Support Cards will automatically undergo <color=#ff9900>Limit Break</color>.
Cannot be exchanged for unowned Support Cards or Support Cards that are already fully uncapped.
63.330:
In the <color=#ff9900>Pretty Derby Scout</color>, you can obtain Trainee Umamusume and pieces.
If you pull an <color=#ff9900>already-owned Trainee Umamusume</color>,
she will be converted into <color=#ff9900>Goddess Statues based on her ★ rarity</color>.
63.331:
In the <color=#ff9900>Support Card Scout</color>, you can obtain Support Cards.
If you pull an <color=#ff9900>already-owned Support Card</color>,
it will automatically undergo <color=#ff9900>Limit Break</color>.
63.339:
By setting a <color=#ff9900>Representative Umamusume</color> and <color=#ff9900>Support Card</color>,
you can assist your followers with their training.
You will receive <color=#ff9900>Trainer Medals</color> and <color=#ff9900>Friend Pt</color> the next day based on usage count.
(Sent to your Presents box)
63.342:
You can also <color=#ff9900>share to social media</color> your Representative Umamusume's <color=#ff9900>Factor Info</color>,
as well as your <color=#ff9900>secondary Representative Umamusume and Training Supports</color>.
Show off your proudest Umamusume with the Business Card feature!
63.347:
Reach the top rankings in the Main Stage to earn <color=#ff9900>Exclusive Titles</color> based on your final rank!
Fight your way through high-level races and aim for the top!
63.348:
Trainers who finish ranked 1st through 96th in the Main Stage
will have <color=#ff9900>Special Prizes</color> shipped directly to them!
Eligible Trainers will see an entry banner on the Home screen
after the event concludes, so please check there for details.
63.374:
Spend dedicated <color=#ff911c>Ability Pt</color> to activate <color=#ff911c>Trainer Abilities</color>
with various helpful training effects for a <color=#ff911c>set duration</color>.
Activate abilities tailored to your training goals
and raise your Umamusume effectively!
63.378: You can switch between "Standard Training" and "Self-Training" from the tabs in the final confirmation pop-up!
63.383:
Ability Pt can be obtained from the Training Pass and various events.
Additionally, purchasing the Premium Pass for the Training Pass
will allow you to earn even more Ability Pt.

\"Noisy right from New Year's... *sigh*, dreading rest of year.\"

\"Hawawawa! S-Sorry~~! Tripped and can't stop~! Out of way~~!!\"

\"Eh!? D-Don't come this way...!\"
88.30078:
\"K-Karuta tournament starting! Hawawa...!? T-Trembling~~! What to do!\"

\"No worries, Doto-san! Sing and dance Shiraoki-sama's 'New Year Happy-Come Ondo', fortune rises, all solved!\"

\"Happy come-come, good luck out♪
Dazzling first sunrise♪
Fuji smiles with blushing cheeks♪
Funnyaka hannyaka fortune comes~♪\"

\"Funnyaka hannyaka~... ehehe. Humming along~\"

\"Ooh, like that! Continue together~!\"

\"Lucky exciting pine decor♪
Everyone gather, Fukuwarai♪
Hawk swoops, prophetic dream♪
Funnyaka hannyaka fortune comes~♪\"

\"Fortune Osechi feast♪
Full happiness calls victory♪
Don't grill eggplant, pocket it♪
Funnyaka hannyaka fortune comes~♪\"

\"Shiraoki-sama's divine blessing secured! Set sail on big ship... treasure ship~~!!\"
88.30079:
Many things out of reach.
Big, dazzling admiration...
Faraway peak... proud self.

Reaching means reborn. Know it, yet out of reach.

So stretch tiptoes slightly. Barely noticeable amount. Someone pushed back.

Want to look back, but won't. Stretch on tiptoes little more instead. Back feels so warm. ...Voiced before knowing.

\"R-R-Reaaachーー!!\"
88.30080:
\"Secret manual borrowed (without asking) from master! Wow, here it is☆ Only read half... let's see.\"

One: Seek Umamusume mystery.
One: Drive techniques into five organs and six bowels.
One: Know experience surpasses talent.
One: Train without drowning in worldly desires.
One: Sasabari needle as mirror of heart.

\"...Ah, left cup ramen water boiling! Pour fast... weight to hold lid...\"

\"...Found great one! Secret manual thick, perfect for lid! Wow, relief☆\"

...3 minutes later, Sasami Anshinzawa caused fuss spilling ramen on secret manual.
88.30081:
\"Photo from then arrived! Wait... shadow... Anglerfish ghost!?\"

\"Kya... where, where? A-Anglerfish ghost...!\"

\"Rice-san, please calm down, desu wa. Don't take Gold Ship-san seriously.\"

\"Waaaah! Emotion returns! Tears won't stop!\"

\"Cried enough back then. ...Tear ducts broken?\"

\"Ahaha~... Ah! Must show Suzuka-san!\"

\"Secured digital data anticipatedly, desu wa. Fufu... unchanged despite fierce battles.\"

\"Yeah! Best Sirius vibe!\"

\"Y-Yeah... Rice too. Unchanging is nice... ehehe.\"

\"Hmph... not bad.\"

\"Yes! So Team Sirius stays close from now on――\"

\"Work hard as one, hell yeah!!\"

\"W-Why take my line~~!!\"
88.30082:
Important thing is piece of small courage.
Feeling of stepping forward.

Mix all together, bake gently, wrap softly, tie ribbon, complete.

Now, look up...

\"Will you... accept this?\"

With best possible smile.
Hands still tremble.

Want to convey. Pray it reaches.
88.30083:
\"Flour!! Butter!! Flour!! Butter!! Cream!! Cream!!\"

Recipe, temperature, disregarded.
Meaningless before her.
Pure explosive speed, bakushin.

\"Whoa, cream in eyes, nose, mouth!! ...Mmm, delicious!!\"

\"Final topping!! Cherry blossoms, blossoms, blossomssss!!\"

Petal storm dancing grandly. Blooming at explosive speed, kitchen dyed cherry color.

\"――Yes!! Completed!! True Bakushin-style!! World's fastest sweets!!\"

Handed with satisfaction, accepted with smile.

Cream on hands, cherry blossoms on clothes... all part of charm.

\"HAAHAHAHA!! That look!! Yes, yes, I understand!! Utterly satisfied!!\"
88.30084:
\"Um, hands like this...?\"

\"Yeah, looks good. Stay like that a bitー\"

Don't know if right way to hype Flower-chan.

I run on impulse, no fancy words, bad at cheering up.

Can't leave her alone. Want to do something.

My way. Lucky if it works.

\"Wah, pretty...! Feel like big sister...!\"

\"...For real? Like it?\"

\"Yes, wonderful!\"

――Nice. Looking good.

Winner takes all? Bad at overthinking, things work out if you just do it!
88.30085:
Popular Umadol autograph session. Holding new CD, Agnes Digital lined up dead last...

\"Wait, hold on, craaazy! Real halo visible...!? Hyohoooo~~!!\"

\"Breathing same air in same space!? Blessed, truly blessed~!\"

\"Fuwaaa~~!? Turn coming closer! B-B-Beyond jacket photo... so goood...!\"

\"...Dangerous! 5 seconds to ascension! Divine field! Oshi right there...!\"

\"...Snap out, Digi-tan! No time to trip out! Simulate properly!\"

\"Casually without leaving impression... get autograph -> 'Always supporting you' -> swiftly move to next person... perfect!\"

\"Manners violation risks future autograph sessions...! Maximum gratitude for being here! ...Going in!\"

Agnes Digital bravely facing autograph session. Her back looked bigger, stronger than ever... maybe.
88.30086:
3000m long haul.
Long steep slope extending from Turn 3.
Far journey unyielding to mere 'effort'.

Sweat running down forehead knew no dryness, frantically obscuring vision.
Pounding heartbeat turned to scream, rough breath scorched throat.

Asked heart. Why run through pain. Why move heavy legs forward.

Before answering, earth-shaking cheers... voices of expectation reached ears.
Savoring every bit painted over all hardship.

Formidable shadow identified as arch-rival threatened from behind.
Looking back forbidden.
Giving up forbidden.
Sole path leading to peak.

...That day, Umamusume refusing to give up most became strongest Umamusume.
88.30087:
\"Wait... Ah, Bright!
Stop, stooop! That's enough!
Sorry, timer display broke!\"

\"Haa, haa... whew~~.
Come to think of it, felt like long set~\"

\"Probably equal to 3 sets!
A-Are you okay...?\"

\"Yes, perfectly fine~\"

\"Not worn out after all that... hard work paying off!
Could you have kept going if I didn't stop you...!?\"

\"Fufu, yes.
Likely would have continued without noticing~\"

\"Ahahaha! Classic Bright!
Some things never change...
Ehehe, known you since childhood, happy like it's my own success!\"

\"To hear you say so...
Glad I strove to hold head high as Mejiro.\"

\"Step by step,
will keep moving forward~\"
88.30088:
\"What do you two think of Tracen Academy?
Different from what you imagined?\"

\"Yes... Just like Spe-san said,
completely different. Right, Kita-chan?\"

\"Yeah. Totally different.\"

\"Eh, really!?
Was it disappointing!?\"

\"No... rather—\"

\"Way more fun than expected!
Training, races, all beyond imagination!\"

\"Yeah! Feels like festival every day, non-stop excitement!\"

\"Pheeew~~, thank goodness...
Thought heart would stop from shock~\"

\"Same for me though.
New things happening one after another...
Thrills just keep on coming!\"

\"Even for Spe-san...!
Waa~! What should we do, Dia-chan!?\"

\"Yeah! What's gonna happen to us from now on...!\"

\"Ahaha! Excitement beyond imagination awaits!
From now on, more and more, forever!\"

\"Yes!\"
\"Yes!\"
88.30089:
Amidst roaring stands,
man muttered with trembling voice.

\"Waited so long...
Expected great things, cheered on, yet no results... just like me.

Yet that girl won...
Believed in herself, never gave up...\"

『—Did it reach you? Marvelous☆
You are super marvelous too★☆★』

Hot tears ran down man's cheek.
Finally realized truth that was always there—

\"I'm... marvelous too...\"

Thus, another light of marvelous was kindled in world.
88.30090:
Your steps bare fangs.
Supple movement, like beast targeting prey's throat.

\"Seems you haven't dulled.
Practicing diligently in secret, I presume?\"

\"Bullseye. Wanted to shield you from public eye, since you can't soar without everything laid out.
O 'Emperor' hoisted on pedestal.\"

\"Then let us hear your 'tale'.
If not hastily patched together,
all ears to entrust everything to you.\"

Your turn shatters silence.
Sneer turns to breath, forehead beginning to glow.

\"Take you along if you want.
Don't forget though.
Payback for leading me on will be exacted in full!\"

\"Whoa there! Dangerous footwork.
Trust in partner is paramount.
Lest you forget again, Sirius...
Time for lesson.\"

Your chase corners.
Surge seemed like thirst for dominance.
...Then shall receive with all heart and soul.
Symboli Rudolf, \"Emperor\", stands here.
88.30091:
\"...Hey, what do you see from there?\"

\"Restless fleeting shadows?
Or dust kicked up by someone?\"

\"Yeah, boredom lying around everywhere.
Sticky and troublesome like mud.\"

\"Sink into it as is...
Or struggle futilely...
Something like that, right?\"

\"But you got third option.
Take this hand—\"

\"Show you what lies beyond boredom.\"
88.30092:
Energy = mass × speed of light squared.
Equivalent exchange through and through.
Get back what you pay.
Put another way: shake upside down, no extra return drops... Just how I like it.

『So hyped up!
!monad is best, right!?
Whooooo!!』

Noise mixes in, equation breaks straight into chaos...!
Yet here I am—

\"Bring it on. Won't let you off easy.
Make you so drunk you lose your senses...!\"

In this cache full of uncertain factors—

\"Come on, keep up...!
Ha... haha...!\"

Why struggling so hard to hold back laughter?
...Tch, am I one being played?
Solution reached... I'll admit it.
So—

\"...Keep lights off till my beat settles down.\"
88.30093:
Love blue and white.
Refreshing, yet vibrant.
Refined, without pretense.

Colors bringing me closest to self I want to be—

\"Yup, this combo is best♪\"

Coordination: check.
Frills: check, pleats: check.
Ribbon bow: perfect balance.

Posture: check, smile: check!
Flawless 'honor student on day off'!

\"Important outing, after all...
Must wear most inspiring 'racing silks'♪\"
88.30094:
Sometimes scolding, encouraging, sharing.
Always supporting someone that way.

Today too, observing world from stands to push someone forward.

Swinging team banner well over 10kg,
no matter how loud voice raised,
everyone's eyes fixed on race.
Where you stood was unlit shadow.

Yet gave all strength without care,
fulfilling role.
Believing it right.
Holding it high with pride.

\"Hang in there.\"
Words slipped out.
Faint sound almost drowned by daily noise.
Voice vanishing without reaching anyone.

Even so... you turned back.
Arms waving banner, voice cheering never rested.
Just for split second, like flickering flame...
You flashed that smile.
88.30095:
Spectacular race viewed from stands.
Umamusume swimming across course at tremendous speed.
Cheer louder than momentum echoed across venue.

\"Nice turn! But chasers coming!
At this rate... ah!\"

Did she have favorite runner?
Looked genuinely disappointed...
Or so thought—

\"Good job! Splendid overtake!
Fruits of training showing!
Keep going! Go!!\"

\"Eh...!? Weren't you cheering for leader just now...?\"

To my unintentional question,
Seeking the Pearl gave bright smile.

\"Races decide winners and losers.
Light and shadow always follow.\"

\"...Yet in fighting with all one's might,
no above or below, no win or loss.
Brilliance deserving praise!\"

\"Cheers to all Umamusume!
Applause to all Umamusume!
Will keep supporting every Umamusume!\"

Pure, unclouded like pearl.
Drawn into that light... colors of world reflected in my eyes changed.
88.30096:
Cornered: slip up for second and overtaken.
Formidable foes closing in, cheers suddenly reach ears...!
Just like—

『Purify! Don't lose!』

Back then, cheering in front of TV, turning voice to power against evil—

『Right there! Get 'em!
Purify!』

Figure of princess showing shining hope...!

『Go! Purify!』

Only one answer.
As princess, absolutely... absolutely—

\"Like I'd... loseeeeeee!!\"
88.30097:
Track in worst condition.
Yet brushed off mud, split pack, seized lead.

Torn turf,
flying droplets,
even us ahead.

Weaving through,
overtaking,
leaving all behind—

Glanced sky-blue eyes when overtaken.
Boundless, untameable, free...

\"Mr. C.B. crosses line first!
First leg of Triple Crown claimed by Mr. C.B.!\"

Among runners coated in unrecognizable mud,
she alone stood special.

Boyish gesture wiping mud off cheek with back of hand.
Easygoing smile curling lips.
Arm thrust high into air toward crowd.

Forgetting even defeat,
watched spellbound.
88.30098:
\"~Brand new racing silks~♪
Aiming for 1st place in race~!\"

\"~Wearing exciting silks~♪
~Running with lots of thrills~♪\"

\"Hop hop♪ Zoom zoom♪
Full blast whooooosh!\"

Classmate singing something.
Familiar sight, yet caught my attention today.

\"...What song is that?\"

Spoke before realizing.
Heart stirred by sheer joy.

\"Racing silks song!
Super excited to run in this!
Full blast whooooosh!\"

Running is fun.
Fun, so sing.
Such simple, straightforward feeling.

\"—Must be nice.\"

Forgot what 'fun' felt like.

\"Wanna sing together?
Ready, set, go!\"

\"Eh... um,\"

\"Ready, set! Hop hop♪
Zoom zoom♪ Full blast\"

\"W-Whooooosh...\"

\"Whooooosh!
Ehehe, looking forward to next race too!\"

—Strange. Singing together
made fun feelings bubble up.

Races meant to be fun.
No need for complex thoughts.
I'll just look forward to race too!
88.30099:
\"Fwaah~...
Ikuno-san, so pretty...
Like real bride...!\"

\"Rice-san.\"

Wearing wonderfully designed silks, watched over by everyone...
Feeling rather embarrassed.

Yet rare experience.
Face shoot properly—

\"Eh!? Ikuno, a bride!?
No no! Don't wanna!
Don't get married, noooo!!\"

\"Wait, Turbo, what are you doing!?
You're disrupting the shoot!\"

\"Noooo!
Don't leave me behindaaaa!\"

...Turbo-san jumping to conclusions caused slight chaos at shoot.

Turbo-san, who flees far ahead in races,
making fuss crying 'don't leave me behind' is amusing.

\"Turbo-san, calm down.
Going nowhere.\"

No reason to part.
We are still mid-race.

—Once shoot ends,
shall join Turbo-san's training.
88.30100:
Wedding scene once witnessed—

Bride smiling softly,
smiles spreading around,
everyone filled with happiness.

Scene unforgettable even now.

Want to make everyone smile like that.
Want to spread happiness to all.

Modest, cherished dream.

Gather courage, step forward.
Beyond step, smiles unfold.

Admired wedding view from that day.
Happy scene bride was seeing.
Felt like caught glimpse...

\"...Want to make everyone smile more and more.\"

Keep spreading smiles to all.

May happiness reach everyone—
88.30101:
—Reckless.

Speed surpassing light would wear out before goal.

While all thought so,
she alone smiled ecstatically.

\"Ah, wonderful...
Splendid...! Truly delightful!\"

Piercing recklessness with theory, subjugating it.
World saturation rising—that sensation—

\"Fufu... Now, next experiment...
What ecstasy awaits...!\"

—Known only to her.
88.30102:
Dober-senpai too kind,
overthinking and worrying about everything, yes?

—How El knows?
Because El was saved by senpai's kind, thoughtful heart!!

\"—Match starts now, desu!\"

Red corner: Tracen Academy's Phantom Bird,
Masked El!

Opponent, blue corner:
Mejiro's Señorita,
Troubled Dober-senpai!

Rules simple!
Listen to Dober-senpai, chat with Dober-senpai, make Dober-senpai smile for total victory!
...Fufufu, no way El loses, desu!

\"With mask, El is energetic, brave, invincible, desu...!\"
88.30103:
In fairytale forest,
two Umamusume hanging from vines, cutting through wind—

\"Um! Taiki-san!\"

\"What's up? What is it?\"

\"In this situation, something I really wanna do...
No, wanna say?
Wanna shout...?
Right now!\"

\"...! I see!
Feel same way as Tannhauser, desu!\"

\"Oh! Together on three...
3, 2... 1!\"

\"\"Aa-aaah~~~~~~♪\"\"
88.30104:
『Waterside where water demon lures,
garden where fairy leads,
door indicated by star...
Overcoming numerous trials,
villagers who finally reached destination greeted by magnificent spectacle—』

\"Amazing...!
Walls really glowing blue!\"

\"Really like different world...
Such place existed...!\"

『At dreamlike view,
voices burst from villagers naturally—』

Ah, ah—!
Truly inside that story right now!
88.30105:
『Become Japan's number one Umamusume』

That was my dream.
Precious promise with Mom.

Yet dream was like mist on cold morning.
Vague, just yearning.
Reaching blindly for intangible.

—However.

Many encounters gave color to dream!
Fierce races with rivals, walls to overcome.
Pain, sadness.
Joy, fun.
All shaped my dream!

Do you have dream?
Uncompromising wish?
Let's chase it together!
To seize your precious dream!
88.30106:
Race with mother-daughter Oaks sweep on line.
Venue buzzing with rumors, tremendous pressure weighing on shoulders.

Moment \"Empress\" appeared, gale blew, sweeping away noise.
Ruling even wind, walked toward starting gate with dignified strides.

Sharp gaze commanding total submission.
Fingers clenched tight into palms.

Seeking ideal. Desiring victory.
Weapon: pride as \"Empress\".

\"—Will win, without fail.\"
88.30107:
Chobegu Big Sis weather forecast♪

Clear skies for me today☆
Hot and groovy midsummer sun hitting everyone's hearts!
Trendy to party at beach♪

Fun times fly...
Might get bit chilly toward evening?

Dusk brings slight sentimental advisory.

No worries!
Not just sun shining on me...
Got groovy presence heating me up with warmth♪

Soak in sentimentality bit, gentle sunshine tomorrow again♪
88.30108:
Desire: electrifying instant.
Simple as possible,
most thrilling stage.
Awaiting opponents' <Raise>.

Fate in enemy hands...
that kind of game.

—Moment of judgment.

Burning fate together this instant.
Falling flames.

Yeah, exactly.
For this moment...

\"—Can't get enough of this.\"
88.30109:
『Where there's chobegu spirit, there's sakura spirit』

(Source: \"A Certain Heated Battle\")
Just as some run inspired by chobegu spirit and lifestyle, desire to support someone you admire bears fruit when clashing earnestly.

(Commentary)
Made it this far thanks to admired figure.
Now my turn to become their strength!
To enjoy and burn with passion—
Going all out to take down my idol!
88.30110:
...Welcome.

Came... today as well.
...Yes...
Helping father here for a while...

Order is...
Usual black coffee, yes.
Bring it right—
............With extra milk?
No... no issue.
Just... unusual, thought...

...I see, very busy... then.
............

—Um... said right away, but...
Could I have little time?

『One cup tailored for customer』

...Taught by father.
Thought I'd add... special touch...

What kind?
That is—

...Surprise for later.
88.30111:
In races or anything,
excitement beats nervousness when facing challenge.

People say 'you're curious',
not just that.

Sparkling feeling directed at me after finishing, after crossing line!

Excited right now. Wondering what brilliance waits beyond showdown!
Steering machine, definitely—

\"~Blue muffler fluttering in wind~♪
Turning wheel, roaring ultimate machine~♪\"

\"Teio-o-o♪ Teio-o-o♪\"

\"Teio-O-O!!!\"

\"Geez, Turbo! Thinking seriously here, don't make weird songs~~!\"
88.30112:
Twin Turbo running track full blast today too.

\"Hii... fuu... haa...\"

Always sprinting flat out.
Speed drops each lap.

\"Hey, Dual Booster!
How about break?\"

\"Twin Turbo!
Running one more time, time me properly, Teio!\"

\"Just like in games.
Work hard, get faster!
Never giving up, no way!\"

\"Unleash game skill again!
Here goes, Turbo full throttleee!!\"

Twin Turbo sprints off again.
Quickly decelerates, tottering.

Even so,
running straight ahead relentlessly—

\"...Still looks cool after all.\"
88.30113:
Crossing mountains in iron plane—

Normal sight in reality.
Assemble aerodynamic blueprints and parts... different here.

Unseen materials,
unknown principles...

To realize plan, must study world fundamentals...

\"Hmm... equivalent of titanium in our world?
First invention with steam engine...\"

\"Hm...? Transmitter? Power grid covering ground with electromagnetic waves?
Semi-perpetual engine via steam compression?\"

\"Wait, already developed alloy enduring such pressure!?
Far surpassing tungsten!?\"

\"...It's fantasy. No end once you start nitpicking.\"
88.30114:
\"Portraits represent clan's pride.
Honor of achievements and glory etched in history.\"

Voice resounding clearly across elegant landing.
Girl standing before wall filled with portraits.
Slender and fragile, yet gaze dignified and lucid.

\"Mother and grandmother here too.
Numerous race victories, URA awards.
Outstanding brilliance in our clan.\"

Porcelain fingertips trace air.
Supple right hand placed against chest adorned with red ribbon.

\"None belonging to clan exempt.\"

Words echoing across open landing.

Countless eyes lined on wall watched girl's back—
88.30115:
Halloween photoshoot party~ yay☆
Taking super photogenic pics of Pama-chin!

\"Oh~ costume and set super authentic!
Feels like shots gonna turn out fire~\"

\"Totally! Pama-chin,
devil costume fits so well! 100 million points!\"

What was word, alluring?
Pama-chin's big sister vibe pops so well♪

\"Alright, let's shoot!
Pama-chin, get into devil character!\"

\"Eh, get into character...
Little embarrassing.\"

\"No prob!
Greedy devil vibe, snatch everything away!\"

\"Got it, snatch... okay, let's try!\"

\"—You smell so sweet...
Way tastier than candy...♪\"

Woah, heart-melting!
Makes you wanna get eaten by Pama-chin!
Super emotional gorgeous photo born!

—Devil smiling under moon!
Halloween night kicks off!
88.30116:
Halloween cosplay photoshoot!
Taking super photogenic pics of Helios!

\"Ayyy! Happy Halloween♪
How's angel look on me?\"

\"Fufu, fits great! Bright outfits suit Helios best!\"

Always hyping, chasing fun, brightening everyone around.
Energy from Helios feels like angel's blessing...

\"Alright, Helios, move freely!
I'll chase and snap pics!\"

\"For real!? Gonna hand out candy then!\"

\"Ayyyy☆
Angel passing through!
Presenting candy for you all♪\"

Handing out candy!
Helios partying, giving energy to everyone...
Best shot right there.

—Angel shining under sun!
Halloween party begins!

88.30118:
Time.

With each step,
cheers, hoofbeats, pulse—all fade.
Yet—

Soul roars.
Chewed through bitterness already. Then.

\"Only to crush.\"
88.30119:
There lay
regret.
Lament.
Vexation.
Yet along with them,
prayers for future Umamusume—

How noble, great predecessors.
How immense their feelings.

\"Someday—
Someday I will prove it.\"

All prayers
kept pushing backs of us who run present and future.
88.30120:
Divine horses practicing 'Souren'—

\"Yaeno-san dances proudly as if flame has no heat...
Splendid.
Wish to learn: any secret?\"

\"No, no grand secret for novice like me—
Just strangely feel no heat while dancing...\"

\"I see. ...Truly
'Clear your mind and even fire feels cool'.\"

\"Honor if reached that state.
...Fufu, focusing completely on one thing—
thought bad habit, but depending on view, might be weapon.\"

\"Yes, surely...\"

\"Then Yaeno Muteki swears to fulfill duty with unshakable heart before any raging fire...!
Even if fire roasts this body crisp, will dance through unfazed...!!\"

\"Fufufu, splendid spirit.
Getting roasted crisp would be trouble though...
Let's practice safe dancing to avoid that.\"

\"...Osu!!\"
88.30121:
Fan Appreciation Project Invitation

Thank you for supporting Umamusume.
Mihono Bourbon from executive committee.

Ran toward finish line with singular focus.
However—

Enchanted by dream views,
heart almost broken by tall walls,
we were not alone.

Your cheers were there.
Each time heard, stood back up, drew new dreams.

Hooftracks left with all of you approaching 2nd corner.

In racing terms:
warm-up done...
time to pour conserved power into legs and sprint.

Thus, holding Fan Appreciation event with daily gratitude and determination.
Please join us.

Will keep running.
Together with irreplaceable you.

\"...Done! How is this?\"

\"Amazing... stiff tone gone, core message intact...!\"

\"Agree with Suzuka-san.
Estimate fans can participate easily with this.
Conclusion: 'Splendid'.\"

\"Ehehe~! Turned out great thanks to Bourbon-chan's original heartfelt draft♪
Just need everyone to enjoy on the day☆\"

\"Yes.
...Looking forward to... the day.\"
88.30122:
1, 2, 345, 67, 8, 910...
Metronome failing disrupts role.

Ticking, ticking—even intervals, no exceptions.
Beauty is guide.
Listening closely, maintaining balance. Yet—

123, 4, 567, 89, 10...
Leaving disturbed metronome, shoving into box of oblivion.

Emotion, past days, delight, nostalgia, envy,
tears, obsession, resurfacing memories...!
Surging over me now!
Like out-of-tune tin toy, bouncing rhythm cannot be contained!

\"Danke! Danke!
...Danke!!\"

Only crucible of joy remains...
Danke! Only word I can find now!
88.30123:
\"You can make face like that too.\"

Air Groove's words made Narita Brian's ear twitch.
Shot glance as if asking 'Got problem?'

\"Just saying photo turned out nice.
How holy night should be.
Thought you disliked Christmas...
Not so bad?\"

\"Sister doesn't nag no matter how much meat I eat.\"

\"Haha, good. Hayahide wouldn't dampen holy night.\"

88.30289:
A battle to decide the world's strongest dirt Umamusume.
That historic race was also a massive wall towering before Japan.

Many reached for that coveted summit, yet their dreams were swallowed by dust and sand.

Even so, their wills never shattered.
The legacy of built-up effort and bitter trials pushes challengers forward.

"Last year's loss was an asset. Got plenty of knowledge. All that's left is to win! That's all there is to it!"

Trust in accumulated history of Umamusume.
Willed to wipe away regret of narrow defeat.

Fueling everything into resolve, challenger charges.
Kicking up sand, aiming solely for peak.

With people's hopes and fierce rivals hot on heels, she seized hand of Goddess of Victory.

Witnesses to turning point in history share excitement.
Those who kept believing tremble with joy of monumental feat.

Never fading, passed down forever—hero of this drama is named Forever Young.

"Beside the race names held at BC, you will notice a row of zeros. That is the number of times a Japanese Umamusume has won at BC."

"Though there is a history of continuous challenges on both turf and dirt, this is reality. But—we also have gained crucial assets."

"Next page—through past trials, immense knowledge has been constructed. It is truly a culmination."

"Past narrow defeats are future victories. We will win."

"First, establish long-term training plan. Simultaneously dispatch reconnaissance team to America, thoroughly analyzing every BC race. Implement every countermeasure imaginable."

"Time has come to polish pioneers' insights into ultimate brilliance. We will achieve American dream."

"Ticket to become witnesses to history rests in your hands. Allow me to escort you to front-row seat."

"Gonna hype this up to the max! I'm gonna win and change racing world!!"

Forever Young-san, bringing innovation to world with meticulous plans and rare execution. Her running carries people's dreams.

"Won't lose to anyone! I will win!"

Almond Eye-san, believing in unwavering victory with resolute eyes. Her running radiates dazzling brilliance.

"I'll show fruits of my training! I'm the protagonist!"

Kiseki-san, sprinting vividly like unfolding tale. Her running sets hearts ablaze.

"Destiny pushes my back! Victor will be me!"

Epiphaneia-san, seeking to bestow guidance of destiny upon Umamusume. Her running exudes warmth akin to universal love.

Those with will firm as corundum. Those with dreams burning like sunstone.

We who traverse turf shine in vibrant hues, like myriad gems.

—And all of that brilliance reaches higher, reaching up for victory.

Though dreams differ, fingertips touch and hearts connect. Connected hearts forge bond that becomes circle.

Until day dreams, light, passion, and warmth spread across entire world—

"I too shall reach out toward victory. For future wrapped in hope!"
88.30292:
We were always together. When we were little—and all the way until reaching Del Mar.

“She's going for a giant upset! It's close—but it's Marche Lorraine!”

"—Haa, haa...!"

Felt like dreamlike scene. English commentary rushing with intense passion. Roaring cheers shaking racecourse. And—childhood friend running up to me.

"We did it...! We did it, Maru-chan! Like a dream... You and me becoming number one in world!"

"......Love-chan..."

Surely, I must be happiest Umamusume in world right now.

Because I became first Japanese Umamusume to win American dirt GI? —That too.

Or because I seized victory when barely anyone expected it? —Of course that makes me happy.

But most of all—

"...It's because Love-chan was here."

"Eh—?"

"Because you stayed by my side entire time. Dreamed together, worked hard together—and seized victory together."

Because Love-chan was with me—I reached end of this dream.

"We did it, Love-chan. Matching victory sashes... right?"

Surely, this is my journey. Where shall we go next—together with Love-chan!
88.30293:
"...No. Not this one."

Dropping held clothes with sigh.

Struggle before mirror nearing full hour. Yet results completely unsatisfactory.

Not much time left before meeting Heart-san. Forced to make decision.

"But... can't meet Heart-san looking half-baked...!"

Yet hesitation won't stop.

Shopping with her wasn't first time.

Admired senior always takes me out and teaches so much.

『Look at those earrings. Aren't they lovely? Bet they'd suit Daring!』

『Oh my, too flashy making you hesitate? Then I'll wear pair too♪』

『See, start by giving it a try! While doing that, you might find something you love.』

Radiant senior's words keep pushing me forward.

(Still... just admiring isn't enough.)

Want to get closer, stand beside, earn recognition.

So stretched myself desperately, even just through styling. But—

Queen Bee remains high above clouds. Glancing around for help—

"...Ah, that photo."

Two Umamusume dancing in pure white outfits. Standing before admired figure, yet expression held dignified—

In that moment, we stood shoulder to shoulder without doubt.

"Yeah... Then I'll go with this."

Gently taking out pure white blouse bought as splurge from closet.
—Felt doubt vanish.
88.30294:
"Nope. This won't do."

Sighing yet again before mirror.

Makeup and outfit perfectly coordinated. Reassuring self that I am Queen Bee ready to show face anywhere with pride. But—

"Meeting that girl—this isn't enough."

Picturing pure, completely earnest junior.

『Wow, just single accessory changes impression so much... Heart-san really is amazing!』

『Because Heart-san carries herself with dignity, even flashiest items suit her... That must be why.』

Under gaze of clear eyes brimming with respect and admiration, acted as ideal senior.

Yet this should have been usual routine.

Unchanged queenly demeanor carried over from America. Nothing difficult about it. And yet—

(Just for now, feeling nervous.)

Daring possesses tremendous talent, bound to surpass me in near future.

Didn't take long to realize that.

Even so, interacting as good senior to junior who purely adores me. Carrying slightly more tension than when first met—

"Can't show any weakness. Because I'm senior she looks up to!"

"...Yet agonizing over single outfit like this. Can't let her see me like this."

Just then, eye catches photo. Daring wearing pure white outfit, crowning me with flower wreath while beaming with massive smile—

And me receiving it with faint, quiet smile.

Vowed at that moment. Will remain guidepost for that girl anytime, anywhere.

Even if day comes when completely overtaken, will remain back she aspires toward until very end.

"...Then choice is obvious!"

Pulling white jacket from closet, slipping arms through sleeves.

Might look formal, but feels just right for straightening posture.

Since that day, white became another racing silk.

"Now, gotta hurry. Tardy arrival would ruin Queen's reputation!"
88.30295:

88.30301:
"Trainer-san! Won't you help me fulfill my My-Rules?!"

Gran Alegria barged into Trainer's office at 100 mph while shouting. Calming down at 1 mph, asked for explanation: "What My-Rules?"

"Well you see:
'If I say Good-Mile-ning to exactly 6 people before morning salad, wear special outfit.'
'If Nutcracker plays on radio, take photo with special person.'
'On days heart beats fast with excitement, gaze closely at pretty stained glass.'
'If saved miles hit repeating digits, celebrate with 100-mile thrill.'
—Those!"

...Isn't that a lot?

"Yes! So I thought—I'd have Trainer-san take commemorative photo with me wearing 'Muse' dress in front of stained glass in Special Wing lobby! That way, all My-Rules get completed at once!"

"That's a hundredfold mile joy♪ ...Hey, how about it, Trainer-san?"

Charging forward strictly by heart's My-Rules, yet leaving final decision up to me is so typical of her.
—Well, answer was already set.

『Enjoy life alongside this girl and her My-Rules.』
Because that is my own current My-Rule.

"Waha♪ Yay! Let's sign and stamp Special Wing permit right away! My side is already 100-mile ready♪"
88.30302:
"It is almost time to enter... Trainer-san, are you ready?"

Satono Diamond peered into my face with caring smile. Clad in 'Muse' dress racing silk, radiating pure, graceful sparkle—

(Truly, Umamusume like a brilliant gem.)

Shining with more than enough brilliance to make one realize anew.

Satono Diamond earned seat of 'Muse.' 'Outfit Debut Gala' held by entire Satono family to honor that achievement.

At such grand event, is it right for me to walk beside her? Out of place? Unworthy? Diamond herself worked hard to become Muse—ruminating on that... evidently showed on face.

"Trainer-san, hold your head high."

"The Diamond standing here right now—is the Umamusume polished by none other than you."

Eyes gazing straight forward resembled light illuminating darkest gloom.

"...Therefore, please escort me with intent of showing me off to everyone in Satono family♪"

Told that, nothing left to do but straighten back and square shoulders. —One deep breath.
Taking extended hand gently as if holding precious jewel, stepped toward doors leading to hall.
88.30303:
"It's fine, come on in!"

Blast One Piece's voice answering knock on green room door sounded completely normal. So opened door "normally."
Yet beyond opened door stood—

Gracefully braided rich hair. Pale green fluttering lightly, wrapped in delicate embroidery—girl resembling gentle breeze rustling through flower garden.

"Uh... um............ Wh-What's wrong, Trainer?! D-Does Boo's outfit look weird...?!"

Suddenly. Seeing her run over with rich hair swishing softly, completely her "usual self," smile broke out naturally.

Just surprised because vibe was so different from usual. Nothing weird at all, suits her wonderfully.
—Conveyed honest feelings directly.

"Ehehe... Hearing that makes Boo blush..."

"But super happy!! Super, suuuper happy!! Boo is so glad to become Muse~~!"

Catching momentum as she leapt in hug, murmured inwardly, "Ah, still same usual 'gust of wind' after all."
88.30304:
Took lead on final straight. All that remains is running straight to goal—

"Now, time for curtain call—with my magnificent victory!"

Ah... Opera O-san after all. Already closing in right behind.

Know view waiting ahead. Burned into eyes countless times before.

Even when launching move at absolute best timing, Opera O-san stays one step ahead. When chased, overtaken without fail. When chasing, never reaching.

Not just during races. Constantly admiring, yearning, yet back I could never hope to catch.

This time, next time, time after that. Surely same view continuing forever—

(—No! Not this time...!!)

Opera O-san in 1st, me in 2nd. Challenged countless times, always same result.

Even so... must not think 'it'll just happen again.'

(Because... I still don't want to give up...!)

By 2 and half lengths, by half length, sometimes—by mere nose. Placed second again and again and again. Shown Opera O-san's greatness closer than anyone.

Yet kept admiring all along. Rather, wish grew stronger.

Want to become like Opera O-san. Don't want to think 'someone like me.' Don't want to stay inadequate. Want to believe I can shine properly.

Old me couldn't even dream of this. Met Opera O-san, learned to wish with all my heart.

That's why—

"That's why... I won't lose...! This time, absolutely...!!"

Haven't conveyed true seriousness to Opera O-san yet. That frustrates me so much.

Not just about wanting 1st place. Want to answer Opera O-san's brilliance with my own shine—

"—! This stride... Don't tell me hero has claimed sword [Nothung]—!"

Even just few centimeters more. Push forward, push ahead—!

"I am... going to wiiin!!!"
88.30305:
—Face while eating is mirror reflecting life. Running shop for years makes one think that way.

"Chef, can I get another bowl of Tanmen? ...And glass of draft beer!"

Lady who mentioned working in entertainment industry looks completely fulfilled every day. Evident from expression and appetite.

"Second bowl already...! You really love Tanmen, Hello-san."

"Ahaha... Love it of course, but irregular meals make this sort of compensation... Gets both vitamins and fiber!

...Ah, Chef! Seasoned egg topping too! Fufu, protein covered now♪

Tazuna-san is... classic royal road. Shoyu ramen with no extra toppings."

"Fufu. Nostalgic shoyu ramen brings comfort, so order it naturally.

During student days, visited shop near tree-lined avenue... Appearance wasn't flashy, but simple, straightforward shoyu ramen was signature dish never growing tiresome."

"Heeh~! Tazuna-san's after-school student life revolved around ramen shop...!"

"Initially walked in thinking of it as reward to self for working hard...

Shop owner asked, 'Did something good happen?' Hearing story, owner smiled and served extra-large portion. Before realizing... fufu, became regular."

"Wah! Sounds wonderful, that kind of shop!"

"Yes. When hard work bore fruit. Before taking on big challenges. Listened and pushed my back.

—Even after painful times. Shop owner and friendly regulars listened gently.

Visited constantly until shop closed amidst regrets.

...Oh? Hello-san?"

"*sniff*...! S-Sorry... Suckers for stories like that~~~...!!"

"A-Ahaha...

...Perhaps that's why. Seeing shoyu ramen resembling those days makes me order it instinctively.

Even when visiting Hakodate or Sapporo, chose shoyu over salt or miso... Probably felt familiar taste offered energy."

Indeed, meal face is mirror of life. Those eyes... understand completely. Bowl reminiscing on bygone youth.

...Quite connoisseur though, knowing legendary old shop...

"Still, this broth is rich in flavor... marvelous!"

Heh. Yeah, ramen evolves with times. Ours isn't just classic nostalgia. Taste reached through relentless refinement... Wonder if missy can tell—

"Chicken... scallops... kelp... Ah, includes dried shiitake too? Simmered painstakingly over time. Extracting stock so flavors don't overpower one another. Chef's passion for prep work... truly admirable."

Missy looks over while saying that. ...Heh! Quite a shock. Missy... ain't ordinary. Guess was spot on...!

120.1: With an outrageous declaration, young academy director Akikawa establishes a new race named the <color=#FF6D26>URA Finale</color>! Trainers and horsegirls work hand in hand to become its maiden champion!
120.2: $(scale 95)Team up! A new experience awaits! Those words captioned a new team event — the <color=#FF6D26>Aoharu Hai</color>. But before the fun can start, the academy faces a crisis!? Stand united and claim victory to save the freedoms of Tracen Academy!
120.3:
Why do horsegirls sing? A producer appears with a project — the <color=#FF6D26>Grand Live</color>. Horsegirls face their concerts from a different perspective, and find their 
own answers!
120.4: The media has concocted a new racing event — the <color=#FF6D26>Twinkle Star Climax</color>. A battle to determine who stands at the top! Run towards your own climax, chasing your dreams!
120.5:
$(scale 90)A support AI carrying the names of the 3 goddesses is the newest development to confront trainers in their quest to support
their horsegirls with all they have. Through the wisdom imparted this way, they aim to reach new heights in the <color=#FF6D26>Grand Masters</color>.
120.6: $(scale 95)Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the peak of international racing. Those who seek their victory at the top of the world every year. <color=#FF6D26>Project l'Arc</color>, newly established at Tracen Academy. The curtain rises on a wistful journey of chasing dreams.
120.7:
$(scale 95)The <color=#FF6D26>H.A.F.</color> is a multi-sport competition to crown the number 1 horsegirl athlete, and it begins now! Horsegirls drenched in sweat test their limits in 15 sports disciplines! 
Witness their shared athletic spirit!
120.8: $(scale 95)Director Akikawa's announcement pushes Tracen Academy into a farming boom! The sun beckons all to the fields until the moon gathers everyone together at the dining table. It's time for another day of hard work!
120.9: $(scale 95)A mechanical horsegirl appears at Tracen Academy. She is the brainchild of genius inventor Sugar Lights. Many issues remain in this early model… so help enhance her and make the inventor's dream come true!
120.10: When the Twinkle Series faces bad times, a few legendary horsegirls step up! Unifying all involved in racing, they seek to push the Twinkle Series back to its heights… and into a new era!
120.11: $(scale 95)The Uninhabited Island Project was the result of taking a chance on Tucker Bryne's dream, passionate horsegirls, and giving in to instincts! Train body and mind out in the wilds, and build the greatest training site ever!
120.12: $(scale 95)The horsegirls' busy lives are interrupted by an invitation to a soothing experience at the <color=#FF6D26>Yukoma hot spring village</color>. But the village has fallen on hard times…!? Rest and peaceful relaxation are important to well-being!
120.13: $(scale 95)The Breeders' Cup. Having once challenged this most massive of G1s on the world stage, Casino Drive seeks victory there with a new campaign. A trial of truly global proportions begins, each horsegirl holding her own desires!
120.14: $(scale 95)Repay fans in ramen! A few horsegirls came up with the idea, and with the help of Light Hello and Hayakawa Tazuna, entrance curtains bearing the Tracen name were soon a common sight across the country!

163.1001:
I'm Special Week!
My dream is to become Japan's number one Umamusume! To make my moms proud... I'll give it everything I've got!
163.1002:
Silence Suzuka. I like running.
I won't let anyone have the lead.
Um............ That's all.
163.1003:
Yahoo, I'm Tokai Teio!
I'm gonna be an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume,
so don't you dare take your eyes off me!
163.1004:
Haaai, Maruzensky here!
You came to see it too, right? My out-of-this-world drive.
Fufu♪ Don't blame me if you fall head over heels♪
163.1005:
I am Fuji Kiseki, the jet-black entertainer here to delight you all!
With the greatest "miracle,"
I promise to bring a smile to your face!
163.1006:
Oguri Cap.
To make everyone back home proud,
I intend to give it my all. Pleased to work with you.
163.1007:
Yo, it's the great Gold Ship!
Through fire, across turf, even to the edge of the universe, who cares!
I'll go anywhere to dig up something fun☆
163.1008:
'Sup, I'm Vodka! My policy is
to be the coolest damn Umamusume around!
I don't do lame crap. Don't you forget it!
163.1009:
...Daiwa Scarlet!
I'll do my best... wait, it's you? Hmph!
I'm aiming for number one. Nothing less is acceptable!
163.1010:
Howdy! Taiki Shuttle here!
I'm gonna make everyone happy
with my super powerful running!
163.1011:
My name is Grass Wonder.
Since I was born an Umamusume, I wish to master that "path" to its absolute limit. Fufu♪
163.1012:
Look at all these fearless faces...
Heh, Big Sis Hishiama will take on every single one of ya! Come on, let's brawl!
163.1013:
My name is Mejiro McQueen. Our family's greatest ambition: conquering the Tenno Sho—
With these two legs, I shall achieve it without fail, desu wa.
163.1014:
The crimson monster bird tearing up the track!
El Condor Pasa is heeeere!
I'm soaring straight for the top of the world!
163.1015:
Hahaha! I am TM Opera O, the strongest and most beautiful Overlord!
Come now, let our legend begin!
163.1016:
...Narita Brian.
Got nothing special to tell you.
I just run, blow everyone away, and win.
163.1017:
Symboli Rudolf. One who stands atop all Umamusume to lead as "Emperor."
Those who share my resolve, let us forge ahead together.
163.1018:
I am Air Groove. Ideals will surely bloom if you hold firm to your convictions. To prove that,
I shall guide everyone as the "Empress."
163.1019:
G'day! Digitan here!
I stan sparkling Umamusume cuties!
Every day is pure bliss! So glad I was born an otaku~♪
163.1020:
Yahoo~ Seiun Sky here~
Let's take it easy and go with the flow~
...When you're angling for the big catch, waiting is half the game, right?
163.1021: Tamamo Cross here! I'm gonna win, win, and keep on winnin' to get my name out there! Don't you look down on me just 'cause I'm pint-sized!
163.1022:
Good day, I am Fine Motion! I want to make lots of wonderful memories.
First of all, could you show me a delicious ramen shop?♪
163.1023:
Biwa Hayahide. My goal is to assemble the formula for absolute victory.
...And for the record, my head is completely average size!
163.1024:
Ehehe, it's Mayachin☆
I totally love thrilling, super exciting stuff♪ Nice to meet you~!
163.1025:
...Manhattan Cafe, here.
There is... a friend I want to catch up to...
The one always running ahead of me... Look, right over there...
163.1026:
My name is Miho no Bourbon.
Target parameter: configured to Triple Crown Umamusume.
Please refer to separate data entries for running style.
163.1027:
I'm Mejiro Ryan!
Train hard, stay pumped! Build muscle and stay healthy! Let's get out there and give it everything!
163.1028:
Bono bono♪ Hishi Akebono here~☆
Whether cooking or racing, I'll deliver it to everyone with huuuge love! Nice to meet you~♪
163.1029:
Ah, I'm Yukino Bijin!
My dream is to become a trendy city girl in Twinkle Series! Whew... managed to say it properly...
163.1030:

228.341:
Oh, this is a great song!
I'd love to let all my childhood friends hear it too.
228.342: Going on and on about "even so, even so"... Seriously, those lyrics just refuse to give up. That's why it sticks in your head so weirdly, I guess...
228.343:
Chasing after something intangible...
Haha, there's no way I can listen to this song like it's somebody else's business.
228.344:
I've got it on repeat because I'm working.
The way the beat drops in the second half... nice rhythm... That's all. Now beat it, you're getting in the way of my work.
228.345:
To forge ahead through the endless gloom, one needs a "flame," even if it defies heaven's decree.
A "light of hope" to illuminate the future!
228.346:
I'll be alright—
—Someday, I too—
hope to say those words with my head held high.
228.347:
Every one of these songs gives me energy.
Playing them during cleaning duty really speeds up the work.
228.348:
If anything, I'm kinda into classical music.
Makes me wanna dance.
228.349:
These are all songs that resonate with the heart.
Let us listen to them together over some pear juice.
228.350:
Let's hype ourselves up with some music!
Maybe I'll dance next to you. ...Ah, even if I wipe out, I'll get right back up!
228.351:
Bring forth the melodies that please Us.
You should know which ones they are without Us having to utter a word, yes?
228.352:
Torna-yay-yay~♪ Spin it around~
Towelin' it up at a music fest is totally irresistible☆
Feelin' the summer vibes~♪ Put cha hands up!
228.353:
Whenever I hear this song, the feel of the sand, my shirt sticking to my skin...
It brings back all the best summer memories!
228.354:
Tempo is of the utmost importance in everything...
In that regard, this track is flawless. Do sit-ups to the rhythm of the beat. It works wonders, you know.
228.355:
Y'know, people don't really go to music fests without a push, right? So like—
wanna let me be your push?
228.356:
Trot-trot-trotting into frame, it's Machan.
Try and spot where I've appeared, everyone.
228.357:
Team races really are such a pain!
You'd better be grateful that I even bothered to join in!
228.358:
Carrying our souls...
charge straight through the raging waves!
SHAKEROCK!
228.359:
Listening to this made me crave sushi!
Let's go get sushi! Maya wants salmon mayo♪ What about you?
228.360:
Playing this song puts the little kitty on my back in such high spirits!
Turns out beckoning cats love fish too~♪
228.361:
Aiiiming for the suuuummiiiit~♪
"Aiming for the summit"... Those lyrics are practically tailor-made for me, wouldn't you say?!
228.362:
Um... I was told it was an ondo folk dance, so I totally assumed it'd be slow-paced...
Wouldn't any regular person think the same?!
228.363:
Gathering around the festival tower and spinning with fiery passion...
Guess it's pretty much a battleground, huh...
Heh... I don't hate it.
228.364:
"T-DK"...
Mmm-maaa-maaa-maaa-maaa
NMA NMA MA... Did it "reach" you?
228.365:
Bang! Bang! Burning♪
A cool and hot performance that's gonna set your heart on fire, y'hear!
228.366: Oh, this one! Whenever we go to karaoke, we all sing it at the very end! But... it makes me tear up, so I've never managed to sing the whole thing... *sniff*
228.367:
Ah, so this was it... the song big sis was listening to.
Good grief, what's she doing sitting there with that goofy grin on her face...
228.368:
Lying in wait, cornering them, and pulling off a massive comeback...
The worse the odds are... the sweeter the payout when you flip the tables!
228.369:
Hehe, it's quite encouraging.
For a traveler bound for the "edge of dreams," that is...
228.370:
Pandora-san said she's going to use my choreography as a reference!
This is... a huge responsibility! I can't slack off for a second!
228.371:
Hmm. Not bad. Perhaps I shall add it to my handheld player... Hm? It is already on there...
Heh... Dear Sister's doing, no doubt.
228.372: Singing along with Sirius-senpai and Ramonu-senpai makes me feel like we're gonna make history together! ♪
228.373:
History is changing. You need one, don't you? A witness, that is. Now then—
don't take your eyes off me, got it?
228.374:
Such passion... It has been far too long.
I must have caught the fever... from this song.
228.375: Legends are born when great deeds are spoken of, spread, passed down through generations, and turned into dreams. In that case, this song will surely become one in time.
228.376:
Prudent at times. Bold at others.
A legend is truly—
the accumulation of fortune and sheer grit.
228.377:
What a soul-stirring song—
The continuation of the dream, the future that lies beyond.
I can picture it ever so clearly.
228.378:
This rush of speed mirrors my own final burst.
A flash of brilliance that leaves no room for clashing blades—I shall continue to display it for all to see!
228.379:
I really resonate with the lyrics.
After all, the future is something you carve out yourself... That's why I'm gonna be the first one there!
228.380:
I shall wear the crown and take center stage with elegance.
Together with my mother's hopes and pride.
228.381:
A blinding gold blocking my view...
Once the scenery beyond opens up, I'm gonna belt this song out with everything I've got!
228.382:
Even on the central stage, I will sing proudly at the top of my lungs.
Surpassing formidable rivals and my own limits, right at center stage!
228.383:
The days of merely admiring from afar are over.
From here on out, I can run on the turf at full power! Next time, it's my turn to sing—!!
228.384:
This is Our song of triumph.
Straighten your back and listen in solemn silence.
228.385: I love music! Whether it's a ballad or up-tempo, my personal rule is to always dance while listening!
228.386: Oho, quite the fine selection of tunes you have assembled! I shall lend you a folding fan, so join me in my dance!
228.387:
You seem to have quite a variety of songs here!
...I wonder if there are any traffic safety awareness songs...?
228.388:
Let's make a bet. Will the crowd get intoxicated by this track or not? If I lose...
this hat is yours.
228.389:
While we were listening in our room, Rob Roy-san mentioned she might want a knit beanie...
Next time, we're going to go buy matching ones together.
228.390:
Whether worn down or pushed up.
Hats have this special power to change your mood depending on how you wear them, don't they? ♪
228.391:
Pulling a hat down low might just let you become a different version of yourself...
That's the kind of feeling this song gives me...
228.392:
Boushies, we~♪
...I sing this at karaoke with my big sisters too~! It really gets the hype going☆
228.393:
A hot and sweet blend...
I wonder if making daifuku feels something like that...
228.394: Saying "don't go," huh. Hearing that makes me wanna leave, but if the tables were turned, would I end up chasing after them, meow?
228.395:
My hand slipped and tossed the sesame tofu, then an angel descended from above...
It ended up in my mouth, so I'm safe, right?
228.396:
Even in a monochrome world, who's the one shining the brightest?
Guess who~?
228.397:
I can feel such an appealing emotion from the melody.
These lyrics... make me want to decipher them as well.
228.398:
Sure, some memories might fade away.
But no matter how fleeting, that doesn't mean they never happened.
228.399:
Mémoire... that means memory, right?
If we're making memories, we might as well pack them with as much fun as possible~
228.400: This track's got some serious speed to it, real nice! From start to finish, there ain't even a moment to catch your breath!
228.401: When it's agonizing and my legs feel like giving out, hearing this song makes me feel like I could start running again... That's how it feels.
228.402:
As a child, I cherished the cap my father gave me like a treasure.
Listening to this brings those memories right back.
228.403:
The dramatic melody stirs my heart.
It fills me with a yearning to reach greater heights, to shine brighter—
228.404:
Are there any love songs on here?
If you find one, let's sing a duet♪
228.405:
This song is all about "love," you see.
"Love" for hats, "love" for our comrades.
If we sing it, it's sure to connect us even more deeply.
228.406:
The historical background conveyed by the lyrics, the musical style reflecting trends of the era...
My mind immediately wanders over to that kind of analysis...
228.407:
What's your go-to karaoke track~?
...Ah. Even if it's old and I don't know it, I'll pick it up in a flash! 'Cause I'm a genius♡
228.408:
Music has a way of soothing the mind.
Even the dark shadows lurking within the folds of one's heart...
228.409:
Resounding loud and clear is the melody of the victor.
When the day comes that I claim the realm, I shall make this melody known across the entire world!
228.410:
Justice is the resolve to keep forging ahead!
This summit this officer races toward is proof of my exemplary dedication!
228.411:
As the fastest, I'll surpass everything.
...Listening to this track makes it crystal clear that the mile is the strongest! It's the absolute best!
228.412:
With elegance, with pride, as befits a queen.
For the day I eventually unveil it, I shall hone myself and prepare for the hour of glory.
228.413:
Don't you think this song is overflowing with "love"?
I want to use this track to give all my followers lots of heart-throbbing excitement in return♡
228.414:
What this melody recounts is a record of glory.
Even across countless ages, the victor's name will surely be passed down alongside the song.
228.415:
For the genius Pandora-chan, even GⅠ races are a total breeze!
I'm gonna make your heart flutter, so look forward to it♪
228.416:
I wish to bloom in full glory for their sake.
...Even a wish that feels too presumptuous to speak aloud can be carried upon this song...
228.417:
Whenever I'm moving heavy stuff at my part-time job, singing this fills me with strength!
Hehe, I even got everyone around me hooked on it!
228.418:
The lyrics are surprisingly deep, y'know?
Like how being true to yourself is the best way to be.
...I bet that really hits home for a lot of folks, huh?
228.419:
Lazing around while dripping in sweat—what a pun!
Well, you got me there!
Give that performer a cushion~~!
228.420:
If I get completely ripped with this song, maybe I can go toe-to-toe with Maruzen-san?!
Repeat!
228.421:
Come on, Trainer-san, join in!
Speed! Power! Stamina!!
We're training every single inch! Come on, let's go!
228.422:
That's the song I recommended to Pandora-san!
She loved it so much... We even sang it together sometimes~!
228.423:
Whenever I sing this, the way I see the world totally changes☆
Like everything looks broader, y'know~?
Hmm, I'll ask Ai-chan what she thinks too♡
228.424:
How was "Me-Ni-Shu-Ki"?
Well, well? Look into Curren's eyes and tell me exactly what you think☆
228.425:
Ah... What a radiant song...
So much so that it fills my chest with a deep yearning...
228.426:
Heart-chan and I came up with some poses♡
All-around adorable makes us totally invincible~♡
So... won't you check out our concert too?
228.427:
Whenever I sing this on stream, everyone floods the chat with comments!
You should try dropping a "Kyu-Kyun♡" too♪
228.428:
Cheval-san gave me a letter with her thoughts on the song...!
So many wonderful compliments... I'm deeply moved!
228.429:
"Conquer the Impossible"!
...What a magnificent phrase.
Someday, I will definitely make it reality!
