325.1032:
A New Year countdown party is to be held at Tracen Academy. 
Preparations are well underway as all horsegirls look to send 
their gratitude to the fans who supported them over the year. 
Among them, Duramente, Royce and Royce, and Cheval Grand 
each harbor their own feelings within their hearts. Will they find an 
answer to their doubts within the exciting fan-centric atmosphere?
325.1001:
The Japan Umamusume Training Center Academy—better known as "Tracen Academy."
Aiming to make her debut in the Twinkle Series and pursue her dream,
Special Week's hectic first day as a transfer student begins now!
Through new encounters and a school life full of ups and downs,
what will Spe find as she takes her first steps toward her dream—?
325.1002:
Following in the footsteps of the one they admired, Kitasan Black
and Satono Diamond enroll at Tracen Academy. Close friends since childhood,
the two have always supported one another. But meeting the colorful
upperclassmen of the academy—and the "ordinary" Matikanetannhauser—
was about to bring a small, but undeniable change to their relationship...
325.1003: The Beauty Dream Cup—a show event where Umamusume race while showcasing bridal gown Racewear crafted by top designers. Harboring their own personal motivations, Mayano Top Gun, Air Groove, and others enter the audition to decide who will be the "Muse" serving as both model and runner, but...?
325.1004: Umanest, a kingdom of swords and magic. Using a VR machine, El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder step foot into a fantasy game world! El the fighter and Grass the healer battle as members of a new race known as "Umamusume." What is the mystery behind the ancient Umamusume legends? And who is the Demon King that rules this world? Hilarious Umagic erupts in this fantasy realm!
325.1005: Special Week and Daiwa Scarlet find themselves lost on how they should run. Seeing their plight, Maruzensky invites them out. "It's the absolute grooviest, hottest spot around!" She takes them to Bubbly Land—a dazzling resort shimmering with discos and nata de coco! In that glittering paradise, the two remember something precious.
325.1006: Mihono Bourbon is appointed executive committee head for the joint dormitory Halloween party. Seeing her run around doing everything alone, Rice Shower wants to lend a hand... but the days slip by without her finding the courage to speak up. Amidst this, Zenno Rob Roy brings a certain proposal to both of them. Preparations for the party have only just begun.
325.1007: The Grand Steed Festival—a traditional ritual holding special significance for Umamusume. Important ceremonial performances are scheduled to take place, including yabusame archery to ward off misfortune and a dedicatory dance offered to the Three Goddesses. Chosen to participate, Gold City and the others confront their own inner feelings as they strive to make the festival a success.
325.1008: Christmas is coming! Oguri Cap is invited to a party hosted by her fans. In return for their heartfelt support, she tries to think of a present only she could give, but... When Biwa Hayahide, Marvelous Sunday, and others happen to gather at the very same place, and the feelings of the fans and Oguri Cap intersect, a miracle occurs—
325.1009: The annual New Year All-Japan Umamusume Karuta Tournament. Utilizing the Umamusume Hyakunin Isshu, this competition is a grand, valiant traditional event often called the "martial arts of literature." Prompted by Matikanefukukitaru's fortune-telling to seek good fortune in the new year, Meisho Doto and her friends enter the tournament. As they struggle through their first karuta match, their bonds grow deeper—
325.1010: Eishin Flash and Mihono Bourbon are set to compete in the Evening Spring Chocolate Contest, an interschool confectionery showdown! Joined by three helpers, they begin developing chocolate sweets themed around "the image of our academy"! What is Tracen Academy? Through seeing, listening, and contemplating—they arrive at a single answer.
325.1011: An Inter-Team Triathlon Tournament is announced at Tracen Academy! After many twists and turns, Kitasan Black, Mejiro Bright, and Narita Top Road decide to take part. Scouting members, team training... facing and overcoming obstacle after obstacle, which team will ultimately seize the crown of victory—?
325.1012: Tracen Academy's traditional spring event—the "Ligne Droite." As preparations begin for this dance party celebrating the new school semester, the partner Fuji Kiseki chooses to invite is... Seiun Sky. In the full bloom of spring, with new battles on the horizon, why do they dance? Tonight, the curtain rises on the Ligne Droite.
325.1013: The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival is a grand event where Umamusume tackle various challenges and enjoy themselves alongside their fans. Appointed leader of the cheer squad meant to hype up the festivities, King Halo drafts one flashy plan after another, dragging Nice Nature and the squad along for the ride. Yet behind her actions lies a certain wish—and on the day of the festival, a cheer echoes across the sky.
325.1014: Once again, the Beauty Dream Cup hosted by Beauty Anshinzawa is underway! This year's Muse candidates will have their "intellect" tested! Seeking the ultimate Racewear, Curren Chan, Fine Motion, and others enter the audition. Will they be able to solve the three puzzle checkpoints and safely reach the "church"—?
325.1015: The Summer Walk—a seasonal event meant to recharge spirits ahead of summer training camp and the autumn campaign. Taiki Shuttle and Mejiro Dober arrive at a lush campsite surrounded by nature! They intended to enjoy standard camping fun like barbecuing and fishing... but end up searching for hidden treasure?! A midsummer adventure woven amidst the fresh-scented forest.
325.1016: The midsummer Splash Recreation kicks off! Mejiro McQueen finds herself entered into the event before she even realizes it, courtesy of Gold Ship. The two clash over their unyielding pride! Meanwhile, Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky also lock horns in heated rivalry. In this chaotic Water Gun Battle, who will emerge victorious—?!
325.1017: The VR-compatible RPG Iron-Wing Steam Chronicles. Set in a city that flourished through steam engines, Winning Ticket and her companions dive into the game world via the VR Umulator, striving to fulfill the dream of a researcher they meet there. But realizing that dream is fraught with hardship. Beyond the countless hopes poured into dreams, what will they find—?
325.1018: The Holy Hoof Festival... Tracen Academy's culture festival. Shinko Windy gathers companions to organize a haunted house, but her stubborn inability to be honest surfaces once again. Some work toward autumn races, while others wish to savor their youth. Amidst the festive revelry where finish orders and race times mean nothing, where will this mismatched group end up—?
325.1019: The Shinme-ku—a venerable Shinto ritual held to honor and soothe the spirits of Umamusume who ran in the past. Chosen as candidates for the "Sacred Steed" who stars in the rite, Tamamo Cross and her companions undergo a training camp to ensure its success, yet trials await on the path to becoming the Sacred Steed. In late autumn, as night falls, thoughts entwine and run from past to future.
325.1020: Furlong Tower—Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka are appointed official ambassadors for its upcoming Christmas event. However, despite being "one-of-a-kind rivals," their excessive awareness of each other leads to misunderstandings. As the differing motivations of everyone involved with the tower begin to move, what wishes will the Umamusume entrust to the Christmas lights—?
325.1021: As the year draws to a close, small disagreements have quietly grown between Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond. Stumbling upon a forgotten shrine, the two team up with the priest to revive the ancient "Uma Shrine Maiden Visit" ritual, but...? With the courage to change serving as their guiding light, they stride forward to welcome the new year.
325.1022: "I want to try being the master of a café just like the one in my favorite shojo manga!" Mejiro Ryan's secret wish comes true thanks to Ines Fujin and the others! With Valentine's Day just around the corner in this season of romance, troubled maidens gather at the café. Through connecting with these customers, the Umamusume also confront what they truly "love"—
325.1023: A new Tracen Academy pamphlet is to be created by the students themselves! Under the concept of "students in their most vibrant moments," various Umamusume bustle across and beyond campus gathering materials. Soon, the gathered materials converge into a single shared sentiment— The curtain rises, the time has come. Leap forth into this expanding new world!
325.1024: The Ligne Droite—a spring event organized by the students of the academy. At this dance party, the most dazzling pair is awarded the title of "Best Date" every year. Aspiring for that honor, Sakura Chiyono O takes her first steps alongside her "date," Mejiro Ardan, seeking the title that only a single pair can claim—
325.1025: Tracen Academy's athletic festival, the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival. Among its events, "Demon Dodgeball" is a massively popular spectacle beloved for its heated matches and victory lives! Utilizing her management prowess to overcome formidable rivals, Ikuno Dictus deepens her bonds with her teammates. Dodge, throw, and cause a commotion—the great spring sports festival begins!
325.1026: The season for the Beauty Dream Cup is here... or is it?! Word reaches the Umamusume that the event has been put on hold indefinitely. It turns out Beauty Anshinzawa has hit a creative slump! Why feel so blue about the things and dreams you love? What will become of this year's Beauty Dream Cup—?
325.1027: The season for the Summer Walk has arrived! Tosen Jordan is thrilled after arranging a trip with her bestie, Gold City. She's all fired up to make the most of summer at a picture-perfect resort! Hanging out with her usual crew and even the Disciplinary Committee Head, she was having a blast spending her days with her favorite friend, but...
325.1028: Tracen Academy's summer training camp is underway once again! Agnes Tachyon is unusually pumped, eager to research the Umamusume during camp. Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka feels gloomy about the unfamiliar camp life. Air Groove makes a certain suggestion to her... A fleeting memory that sparkles gently on a special summer stage—
325.1029: With the Holy Hoof Festival approaching, the Umamusume decide to put on a play proposed by Tanino Gimlet. It is a tragic tale of "parting" that begins on Halloween night... Symboli Kris S strives to fulfill her mission of expressing the feelings of farewell that Tanino Gimlet poured into the story, but— A play is a fleeting, once-in-a-lifetime moment... the curtain rises, and inevitably falls.
325.1030: The season for the Grand Steed Festival has arrived once more. Kawakami Princess and her peers are chosen to perform in Tracen Academy's Dedicatory Play. This year's offering is a "tale of inheritance" between an Umamusume master and pupil. At the training camp, everyone rehearses with boisterous fun... but King Halo finds herself especially deeply invested in the role—
325.1031: Mejiro Palmer and Mejiro Bright are put in charge of a fan event hosted by the Mejiro family. They strive to attract and welcome new Mejiro fans, but the Mejiro family points out flaws in their plan. What secret strategy do they come up with in response? Their goal: a Christmas event everyone can enjoy!
325.1033: Yukino Bijin is shocked to learn that her favorite traditional Japanese sweets shop is closing down. Together with her friends, she offers to help revitalize the shop by creating new wagashi for Valentine's Day. She holds cherished memories tied to wagashi—moments spent with someone dear. She wants to deliver a special sweet to accompany those precious times...
325.1034: The season for the Ligne Droite is here! Becoming a pair—a "date"—at this traditional spring dance party carries a very special meaning. In other words, it's "super adorbs!" Daitaku Helios is determined to dance with her beloved Daiichi Ruby, and she launches an all-out charm offensive, but—?!
325.1035: Yaeno Muteki and her allies take on the Chanbara Turf War at the Fan Thanksgiving Festival. But when whispers circulate that other powerhouse teams are the true favorites to win, her fighting spirit ignites! As if we could ever lose! Facing their destined rivals, the members of Yaeno Muteki's team vow to achieve an upset victory.
325.1036: Beauty Anshinzawa's Muse Audition is back again this year! This time, the judging criteria evaluates their passion: "To whom and how do you want to show off your Racewear?!" Will King Halo, Verxina, Sweep Tosho, and the others be able to clear the labyrinth aboard a luxury cruise ship and claim their Racewear—?
325.1037: The Midsummer Sand Dirt Festival! Requested by the academy, Hokko Tarumae and the others give it their all to make the event a success! Watching over her juniors, Eishin Flash sees her past self and Smart Falcon reflected in their bumpy dynamics. Far away from the academy at a resort, the breeze of youthful summer blows through—
325.1038: The Moon-Viewing Gathering—an on-campus exchange event where students encourage and support one another ahead of the autumn race season, boosting morale academy-wide. Zenno Rob Roy feels especially strongly about this autumn, working tirelessly with the support of her upperclassmen. Meanwhile, Neo Universe, secretly watching over her, comes up with a plan for the gathering—
325.1039: Mayano Top Gun dreams of being in a cool band! She's determined to perform on stage with a band at this year's Holy Hoof Festival... but when she visits a band recruiting members, she finds an unimaginably bizarre group formed by Seeking the Pearl and Matikanefukukitaru! Will their live show turn out to be a success...?!
325.1040: At T.M. Opera O's suggestion, Admire Vega and her fellow classmates decide to make memories together. First, they need to bond! Heading out to a theme park, a sudden turn of events leads them to perform a play scripted by Agnes Digital. All of it is to showcase the greatness of their generation. Aiming for an unrivaled brilliance, the key lies with... Narita Top Road.
325.1041: With the new year approaching, Katsuragi Ace and the others are invited to put on a calligraphy performance. Though demanding under normal circumstances, the routine becomes increasingly intense and challenging to match the members' skill. Will they be able to pull off the performance without a hitch? Carrying their respective convictions, their challenge begins!
325.1042: Aston Machan and Curren Chan lead their "Chan-Chan Alliance" in hosting a special Valentine's livestream! Aiming to bring fun to their fans, they take on various short video challenges. Amidst the excitement, a certain sentiment drifts into the mind of Yamanin Zephyr as she contemplates alone—heading toward the most enjoyable Valentine's Day ever: "#PleaseShare♪"
325.1043: The season for the Ligne Droite has arrived once again! Seeking fame and intoxication, Tap Dance City and Tanino Gimlet aim for "Best Date." Unapologetically true to themselves, these two wild spirits gradually influence those around them, stirring up a whirlwind of excitement! Tonight, who is the coolest of them all? This unstoppable duo cannot be tamed—
325.1044: The Dreamy Night Parade... This year's featured Thanksgiving Festival attraction is a marching band parade planned and directed by the students themselves. Copano Rickey marches to make everyone happy. Espoir City marches... to stand out?! What kind of brilliance will this parade showcase with such a uniquely eccentric crew—?
325.1045: Beauty Dream Cup... The Muse has been chosen! As preparations for the unveiling get underway—"I want to hold a ceremony." Mejiro Ramonu's single phrase changes everything. Cesario and the others are tasked with intensive training for the "ceremony," but find themselves completely run ragged by her utterly unique and enigmatic regimen—?!
325.1046: Satono Crown is set to shoot promotional photos at a Satono Group resort facility. She heads into the shoot with a flawless plan prepared in advance, but... Cheval Grand, one of her scouted models, completely loses her confidence after being overwhelmed by the ultra-luxurious atmosphere! Will they successfully capture the PR photos? A turbulent photoshoot begins...!
325.1047: Through an unexpected turn of events, the girls decide to compete in a small town choir contest! Led by K.S. Miracle and Hishi Miracle, they practice alongside their daily routines, gradually harmonizing their voices. Beyond those ordinary yet precious days, harmonizing their voices and connecting their hearts, what will they discover—?
325.1048: For the Holy Hoof Festival, Marvelous Sunday and her friends decide to put on... a circus! However, numerous hurdles stand in their way, from staffing to safety! On top of that, once the show begins, trouble strikes left and right— Will they be able to achieve the "marvelous" success they set out for...?!
325.1049: Thanks to Gold Ship's pranks, Fenomeno ends up managing the joint dormitory Christmas party. If she has to do it, she's determined to take responsibility and provide a peaceful, relaxing holiday for the students... and yet, Orfevre and the others keep breaking rules and running wild! What will become of the Christmas party?! What will become of Fenomeno?!
325.1050: Five students remaining at the academy over winter break decide to take a trip to Kyoto! Seeing Bubble Gum Fellow and her peers in perfect sync, juniors Fine Motion and Ikuno Dictus catch a glimpse of their unbreakable bond. Those youthful, painful, desperate days of the past... Looking back on their journeys, these seasoned champions look ahead toward an even brighter future at the dawn of the new year—
325.1051: Taiki Shuttle and Sounds of Earth are tasked with teaching sweets-making on a special Valentine's livestream! However, one is overly wild and the other is utterly hopeless at cooking—making sweets normally is completely out of the question! Silence Suzuka and others step in to assist, but just where is this broadcast headed?!
325.1052: This year's Ligne Droite takes Curren Bouquetd'or's wish as its theme. Sakura Bakushin O and North Flight dance for an exhibition match. Daring Tact and Daring Heart dance to claim Best Date. Each takes the hand of their date and steps onto the floor. In the spring evening where heartfelt emotions intertwine—"A Blessed Bouquet for You."
325.1053: The Red & White Matchup at the Fan Thanksgiving Festival! Jungle Pocket aims for victory alongside her idol, Fuji Kiseki, but the two end up on opposing teams! Seeing this unexpected master-disciple showdown, Agnes Tachyon wears a scheming grin. Joined by Tap Dance City, who seeks a battle against Agnes Digital, the heated contest begins—
325.1054: The Beauty Dream Cup returns this year! Chosen as Muses, Gentildonna and her companions visit a certain mansion for their gown photo shoot. But what awaits them are self-closing doors, mysterious shrieking noises, and a series of undeniably suspicious phenomena. Will they scream? Will they flee? No—these maidens stand and fight.
325.1055: The summer training camp season has arrived once again! Almond Eye and Kiseki push themselves relentlessly in pursuit of greater heights, only to get swept up into the laid-back days of Fusaichi Pandora and the others. Tossed about by these mundane moments spent together, what will Almond Eye discover this summer—?
325.1056: As a member of the Disciplinary Committee, Fenomeno launches an investigation into the archive room after hearing rumors of an intruder. But stakeouts and interrogations yield no results! Recognizing their potential, she scouts Samson Big, Shinko Windy, and others to form an investigative squad. Can Fenomeno and her squad solve the mystery—?

Outrunners who are close to each other during the early 
or the middle phase expend energy for extra speed.
The strength and duration of this boost scale with Guts.
450.5:
Increases speed and acceleration when evenly 
matched with a competitor on the homestretch.
Strength scales with Guts.
450.6:
When Power is over 1200, acceleration in the last spurt is increased
in proportion to power conserved up to that point and the amount
of Power. Power isn't conserved during Rushes or Positioning Battles.
450.7:
When Stamina is over 1200, speed in the last spurt is
increased in races ≥2100 m when conditions are right.
The increase scales with Stamina.
450.8:
Trade energy for pace in the middle phase when far from
the lead or close to other competitors. Strength scales
with Power and Guts. Likelihood scales with Guts and Wit.
450.9:
Prevents Repositioning during the middle phase
when lacking energy to complete the final spurt.
Likelihood and accuracy scale with Wit.
450.10:
Trade energy for pace in the middle phase when too close 
to competitors whose running style positions them further back.
Strength scales with Guts. Likelihood scales with Wit.
450.12:
When Speed is over 2000, top speed in the last spurt is increased
when conditions are right. Speed uncap in the All-Out Spurt
increases with Power and Spurt Boost skills.
450.13:
Increases top speed in the late phase by expending energy.
Might be delayed or weakened when lacking energy.
Strength scales with Speed and Guts.
450.14:
Wastes energy on increased speed while disregarding positioning 
during the early or middle phases. Likelihood decreases with Wit.
450.15:
Start reaction time is deemed too slow when crossing
a set value. Some skills can shorten reaction time.

Self-training is done! Will you come see how I did?
469.1115:
You are being disrespectful. How long do you intend to keep me waiting?
I completed that trivial self-training long ago.
469.1116:
I finished my self-training ages ago. Come now, hurry over,
won't you? I shall show you how much stronger I have become.
469.1117:
I finished my self-training, but I'm still not good enough.
To surpass "her"... I need your guidance!
469.1118:
Good work. I have finished my self-training.
Awaiting next orders.
469.1119:
Might you have some free time about now?
I, too, have just... finished my self-training.
469.1120:
Are you sure about this? If you don't come quickly, I'll finish self-training,
go home, sleep, wake up, and start self-training all over again.
469.1121:
I wish to present the results of my self-training to my lord.
So... um, around when might I be granted an audience?
469.1124:
Self-training is complete, but I haven't cut loose enough yet!
What's next? I can handle anything you throw at me!
469.1127:
Self-training has concluded, sir! The report is ready,
so please provide your signature and seal!
469.1129:
I'm done with self-training, but... some girls are still running.
From here on out—you and I are going to overtake them all!
469.1130:
I've finished my self-training, so could you take a look at the results?
Let's gently help those buds blossom together.
469.1131:
Self-training is all done! And I even managed to clear
my special personal rule! Come over and hear all about it if you'd like!
469.1132:
Self-training is over, so wanna have a meeting?
About how we can deliver even more love through our running!
469.1133:
Self-training is complete. During my break, I finished making predictions
for the next race I'm watching... Would you like to hear them...?
469.1134:
Self-training has finished. Please give me your next instructions—
so that we may gather a bouquet of glory.
469.1135:
Self-training done and dusted. How about joining me on my next journey?
I guarantee it'll be a great trip with all the prep we've done.
469.1136:
Now that I have completed my self-training, I believe I shall offer a prayer.
Would you care to behold... the saintly radiance?
469.1137:
[Currently in Serialization] Self-training is complete!
Come see the power I unlocked after my training arc!
469.1141:
Self-training is done! Alright, what's next?
I'm waiting to hear your voice!
469.1143:
Will you check the results of my self-training? If I've managed
to weave hope once again... it is you whom I want to show it to most.
469.1145:
Self-training complete. I can easily manage on my own, but...
with your support, wouldn't we gain an even greater tactical advantage?

464.335: A rich miso broth simmered with local ingredients that warms you to the core. Thick, curly noodles provide a hearty, satisfying bite.
464.336: A clear, golden broth blending the flavors of chicken, pork, and seafood. Smooth straight noodles glide effortlessly down your throat.
464.337: A dried-sardine soy sauce broth topped with rich back fat, perfectly paired with extra-thick noodles. Aromatic nori and minced onions add a refreshing finish.
464.338: A clear soy sauce broth that delivers a clean yet deeply savory flavor. Firm, flat noodles cling effortlessly to the soup.
464.339: A rich tonkotsu-shoyu broth paired perfectly with extra-thick noodles. Piled high with vegetables and thick-cut pork to satisfy massive appetites.
464.340: A pitch-black soy sauce broth infused with pork essence for a mellow, well-rounded flavor. Diced onions and generous chashu make every bite a delight.
464.341: Infused with chili peppers and garlic, this spicy broth retains a deep vegetable richness. Savory minced meat and garlic chives deliver an exciting kick.
464.342: A soy sauce broth rich with chicken and pork flavors, satisfyingly deep yet easy to drink. Drizzled with back fat and garnished with vibrant green onions.
464.343: Simmered with various ingredients to produce a gentle broth with a distinct sweetness. Chewy thin curly noodles pair delightfully with bean sprouts and scallions.
464.344: Slow-simmered pork bone broth offering a deep, creamy richness. Crisp ultra-thin noodles complement the soup so well you'll definitely want extra noodles.
464.345: The culmination of classic soy sauce ramen, brimming with toppings crafted out of pure gratitude. A masterpiece born from ramen training journeys across the land.
464.346: A richly flavored specialty miso broth piled high with a wide array of toppings. A hearty bowl made with true hospitality to deliver an abundance of flavors.
464.347: A meticulously crafted salt broth accented by carefully selected ingredients. An elaborately presented bowl that delights both the eyes and the palate.

401.10001:
An entity manifested in the VR world by an AI
that prioritizes "Courage". Claims to be one
of the Three Goddesses, ancestresses of all Umamusume.
Free-spirited yet consistently calm, she wishes for
today's Umamusume to grow healthy in mind and body.
401.10002:
An entity manifested in the VR world by an AI
that prioritizes "Love". Claims to be one
of the Three Goddesses, ancestresses of all Umamusume.
She loves all and watches over them gently.
At times she tests others to foster skill growth,
all done out of sheer devotion and care.

An entity manifested in the VR world by an AI
that prioritizes "Discipline". Claims to be one
of the Three Goddesses, ancestresses of all Umamusume.
Military-like and stern, her strictness stems from care.
She firmly believes physical strength is the key
to forging a path to the future.
